summary.text: Alina Bonsell is the Republican and Block Mamdani Party nominee challenging incumbent Liz Krueger. A 20-year East Side resident who says she came to the U.S. as a child when her family fled the Soviet Union as Jewish refugees, she describes a career in the pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare and private sectors. She previously ran unsuccessfully for New York City Council District 5 in 2025 and is running on public safety, tax relief and economic growth.

paragraphs.text: Bonsell says in her Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey that she came to the United States as a child when her family fled the Soviet Union as Jewish refugees; in an earlier survey response she said her family immigrated in 1989, when she was a small child.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Hofstra University.
She describes approximately 20 years of professional experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare private sectors, though an earlier survey response gave 15 years.
Bonsell describes herself as a mother and a 20-year resident of Manhattan's East Side.
In 2025 she ran for New York City Council District 5 on the Republican line and lost to incumbent Julie Menin, 73.7% to 26.0%.
She advanced without a primary opponent in the June 2026 Republican primary for State Senate District 28 and also holds the Block Mamdani Party line.
